abi.engineView: getDomainState via QueryCount(0x4000) and QueryCount(0x8000), not MSG location bytes

notes: LOCATION_DECKMASTER is 0x4000. First leave from DMZ is free; each completed return adds 500 LP to the next leave, paid through PayLPCost for every proper leave (NS/MSet/SSProc/effect SS/main Pendulum activate), not non-leaves. Combined LP costs accumulate inside save_lp_cost/restore_lp_cost. The DMZ leave tax is an action cost with a locked null effect reason, including Pendulum activation; Spell Economics cannot waive it. Other card costs still apply normally. Recall is offered to both owners in turn order after chains/triggers at open state when the DM's zone TYPE changed at least once since the last open state (not merely final != previous); field/overlay final locations block; decline consumes until the next transition. DMZ protection also blocks ignore-immunity effects and effect targeting; only valid summon procedures owned by and registered on the DM are exempt. Foreign-owned single effects remain blocked after recall. Non-Link Extra Deck DMs can use any available MMZ or EMZ independently of MR5; Link DMs require an EMZ or linked MMZ, including linked MMZs only before MR4. Recall raises single and grouped EVENT_MOVE with previous-zone metadata and REASON_RULE/no reason player; GY also raises EVENT_LEAVE_GRAVE.
